resources.string: Lets you move an on-screen pointer using fingerprint swipes or phone tilt, and click via double-swipe or a long Volume Up press. Draws the pointer as a small overlay icon.

Turn on the switch below, then enable "Fingerprint Mouse Control" on the Accessibility Settings screen that opens. Pick a control mode below, then check the hint text under it for how to click in that mode.
Find \"Fingerprint Mouse Control\" in the list and turn it on
Swipe up, down, left, or right on your fingerprint sensor to move the pointer. Swipe the same direction twice quickly to click.

Tilt your phone to move the pointer — it moves faster the more you tilt, and stops when the phone is level. Hold Volume Up for about half a second and release to click (a quick press does nothing, so it won\'t collide with normal volume control).
Applies to both modes: how far the pointer moves per swipe (fingerprint) or per tilt update (tilt).
